English

Generated Narrative: CodeSystem KGL2BPMNClasses

This case-sensitive code system http://smart.who.int/base/CodeSystem/KGL2BPMNClasses defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
bpmn-definitions BPMN FileOne BPMN file as a unit -- the `bpmn:definitions` root. Shares its IRI with the l1:external-artifact for the same file, so the component that points at it and the subgraph that opens it name one resource.
bpmn-process BPMN ProcessOne `bpmn:process`. Present as a node because a participant references it by processRef, and without it the pool-to-element attribution has nothing to travel through.
bpmn-participant BPMN ParticipantA pool: a role that owns part of the collaboration. The lifecycle BPMN has 8 and declares no laneSet at all, so the pool is the only unit of role assignment present and its @name is the sole link to a persona.
bpmn-task BPMN TaskA task or sub-process. It is what a DMN usingTask href points at, what sequence flows connect, and what a DAK-level task entry describes. Sub-processes carry isSubProcess rather than getting a class of their own -- the lifecycle BPMN has exactly one.
bpmn-gateway BPMN GatewayA branch or merge. Included for connectivity rather than for a cross-model edge: a flow through a gateway with no node would point at nothing, and every reachability question over the process would break at the first decision point.
bpmn-event BPMN EventA start or end event. Same connectivity argument as gateway, plus one of its own: entry and exit points are what make 'is this task reachable' and 'does this path terminate' answerable at all.
